big-news.text: After the Ukraine talks in Oslo, Støre says Russia, the US and Ukraine have agreed to a new high-level meeting between the three countries, probably in mid-November.

A huge water main burst in Sør-Varanger has left about 6,000 subscribers without water. Kirkenes hospital, which serves all of East Finnmark, is on red alert and is sending emergency patients to other hospitals.
Norway has now given NOK 52 billion in civilian support to Ukraine since 2022.

whats-changing.text: Eight universities have applied to reserve places for men on 19 study programmes starting with next year's admissions.

oslo.text: It's official: the city council has approved Oslo's eight new district names.
An investigation into the city's culture agency (Kulturetaten) found several breaches of the law and a risk of corruption. The city government says it will act on the findings.
A new report found serious problems at two Oslo nursing homes, Uranienborghjemmet and Kantarellenhjemmet.

be-aware.text: Banks are warning about three new scams, including one where people are told to leave gold out in the forest.
A new report from the Norwegian Media Authority says Roblox uses gambling-like features and pressure tactics on kids.

fun-and-free.text: Top pick: Sondre Lerche and his band play Parkteatret on Grünerløkka at 20:00. The listing says it's free, but bring ID.
Asbjørn Ribe plays with his band at Oslo Konserthus on Saturday at 20:00, and the listing says it's free.
Oslofønk spins vinyl at Parksalongen on Friday from 22:00 to 03:00. It's free and 20+.
